source: can you please make a game where u dress up and you have a opportunity for skinny, muscle and fat body tips with opportunity of clothes and you can walk around and explore and interact

answers.ask: Should this be a modern shopping-mall look, a bright cartoon boutique, or a fashion-studio interior?
answers.answer: Use a bright cartoon boutique look, with clear clothing and body-shape options that are easy to explore.

answers.ask: Is there a runway or judging element, or is it purely free-roam dress-up?
answers.answer: Make it purely free-roam dress-up: players can change their body type and clothes, then walk around, explore, and interact.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D free-roam dress-up map set inside a bright cartoon boutique interior. Arrange clear, easy-to-explore sections for body-shape choices and clothing options, with open walkable space connecting the areas and interactive boutique displays.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, specifically a free-roam dress-up experience. The original request centers on avatar body-shape and clothing customization with casual exploration and interaction, not competition or a runway judging loop.

### Shape and preset
Use `interior-single`, taken from outside the genre’s usual shape shortlist. The whole map is one bright cartoon boutique interior: players remain indoors and freely circulate between customization displays. Preset: none; Dress Up assumes a `stage-runway`, but the author explicitly rejects a runway and judging element.

### Config requirements
No additional image-config options apply. The boutique is already defined by the single-interior shape; do not add a social square, runway, audience, exterior entrance, or unrequested NPC population.

### Layout requirements
No canonical placed layout markers are required. The body-shape selectors, clothing racks, mirrors, mannequins, and display counters are visible interactive props and should be built into the rendered layout; their interaction logic is not part of this layout blob.

### Layout components
Build one medium-sized enclosed boutique with a broad central open floor for easy free-roam movement. Put a prominent body-shape selection zone along one side, with clearly separated bright cartoon stations for skinny, muscular, and fat body options. Place the clothing-selection zone opposite it, using organized racks, wall displays, mannequins, shelves, and changing-area-style display alcoves so clothing categories are visually legible. Use a central circular or rectangular display table as the visual anchor, with wide unobstructed walking aisles connecting every section. Add mirrors, decorative fashion signage, soft seating, colorful floor patterns, and small interactive boutique displays around the perimeter. The boundary is the boutique’s enclosing walls, storefront-style interior facade, and ceiling; there is no outdoor area. Compose the frame from an elevated three-quarter view that shows the entire open central circulation area and both selection wings at once.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: the boutique’s visual clarity and cheerful retail presentation lead, and its simple open-floor topology does not require a plan-first render.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale band: medium, driven by distinct body-shape and clothing zones plus generous exploration space within one building. Theme: bright cartoon fashion boutique, colorful, friendly, clean, and highly readable. Pipeline modifier: `P0`, because this is one enclosed single-level interior with no overhanging floors, exterior-to-interior transition, separate maps, or topology that must be generated procedurally.
